title: pickup.fact.accepted v1 payload
description: ADR-0009 C10 — custody-starting Pickup acceptance fact for Shipment apply. Minimum fields Shipment persists without Pickup DB or permanent PickupTaskSnapshot authority.

pickup_task_id.description: PickupTask aggregate id; MUST equal envelope aggregate_id.

shipment_id.description: Payload correlation only — not Shipment aggregate authority.

outcome.description: Custody-starting success only. REJECTED MUST NOT use this event type.

accepted_at.description: Operational acceptance timestamp from Pickup (RFC 3339 UTC). Shipment sets accepted_at and sla_started_at from this value.

assigned_driver_user_id.description: PickupTask assigned driver. Shipment persists as current_custody_id. MUST be the real assigned driver — never producer, event_id, or a placeholder.

acting_driver_user_id.description: Authorized actor of the Pickup acceptance operation. Shipment persists as AcceptanceDecision.acting_driver_user_id and audit actor_id. MUST equal assigned_driver_user_id (Pickup validates before publish). MUST NOT be producer, event_id, or a placeholder.

scanned_identifier.description: Identifier actually scanned at acceptance. Shipment verifies against its waybill_identity and persists on AcceptanceDecisionRecord.
